mapper.select: SELECT , d.code AS metric_code FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id LEFT JOIN metric_definition d ON d.id = o.metric_definition_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.examination_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (d.sort_order IS NULL), d.sort_order, o.original_name, o.examination_date, o.id
mapper.sql: t.observation_id, t.report_id, t.examination_date, t.original_value, t.result_kind, t.numeric_value, t.unit_text, t.reference_text, t.reference_low, t.reference_high, t.abnormal_flag, t.specimen_text, t.method_text, t.original_name
o.unit_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin, o.specimen_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin, o.method_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
mapper.select: SELECT t.metric_code, t.original_name, t.unit_text, t.specimen_text, t.method_text, COUNT(*) AS observation_count, MAX(t.examination_date) AS latest_date, MIN(t.pos) AS first_pos, MAX(t.pos) AS last_pos FROM (SELECT d.code AS metric_code, CASE WHEN d.code IS NULL THEN o.original_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin END AS original_name, o.unit_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS unit_text, o.specimen_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS specimen_text, o.method_text COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS method_text, o.examination_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (d.sort_order IS NULL), d.sort_order, o.original_name, o.examination_date, o.id) AS pos FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id LEFT JOIN metric_definition d ON d.id = o.metric_definition_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.examination_date IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY t.metric_code, t.original_name, t.unit_text, t.specimen_text, t.method_text ORDER BY first_pos

SELECT FROM (SELECT , (o.result_kind = 'EXACT' AND o.numeric_value IS NOT NULL) AS is_exact, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORDER BY o.examination_date, o.id) AS first_rn, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY , (o.result_kind = 'EXACT' AND o.numeric_value IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY o.examination_date DESC) AS date_rank
AND o.metric_definition_id = #{metricDefinitionId} AND o.examination_date < #{before}) t WHERE t.first_rn = 1 OR (t.is_exact = 1 AND t.date_rank = 1) ORDER BY t.examination_date, t.observation_id

SELECT , t.metric_code FROM (SELECT , d.code AS metric_code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.metric_definition_id, ORDER BY o.examination_date DESC) AS date_rank FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id JOIN metric_definition d ON d.id = o.metric_definition_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.examination_date IS NOT NULL AND o.examination_date <= #{to} AND o.result_kind = 'EXACT' AND o.numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND o.metric_definition_id IN #{id} ) t WHERE t.date_rank <= 2 ORDER BY t.metric_code, t.examination_date, t.observation_id
